author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition. Unauthenticated RCE during full core upgrades via predictable, web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. CVSS 8.1 High.

author: webknitdigital
text: CVE-2026-119977 is being actively exploited and affects WordPress 4.7 to 7.1.3. Block web access to wp-content/upgrade, then update to 7.1.4.

author: Kasspar256
text: Zero-day alert: Some WordPress sites can still be attacked while they install the fix for an actively exploited flaw, according to Umut Bayram, the Picus Security researcher who found it.

author: DecryptionDigst
text: SonicWall SSLVPN is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-19868 bypasses both SAML and MFA on Gen7/Gen8 firewalls. CISA added to KEV Nov 6. Federal patch deadline: Nov 20. No workarounds. Patch now.

author: HACKTIFY_
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-19868 lets users with valid alternate-auth credentials bypass SAML/MFA on SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. Affected only with SAML enabled: Gen7 <=7.3.3-7015, Gen8 <=8.2.2-8015. Patch to 7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015 now.

author: fugedizs
text: CISA KEV update: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 is actively exploited and may allow SAML/MFA bypass. Recent KEV entries also impact GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, WordPress and PHP.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH on musl-based systems is actively exploited, with confirmed root access on a honeypot. Search /var/log/messages for 'Accepted password for' on accounts lacking a password hash, then patch and restart sshd.

author: 0daywatch
text: Drupal's security team says Commerce Core CVE-2026-118539 is being actively exploited. Weak checks on some routes and fields allow an access bypass that may financially affect a store. Upgrade to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flags an actively exploited Apple flaw reportedly linked to Russian cyberespionage. Despite its 5.5 severity score, experts urge patching and checks for compromise.

author: Kasspar256
text: Actively exploited: QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server to the latest version in the QNAP App Center, as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain.

author: rst_cloud
text: Threat report: Exploitation targeting Node-RED, a tool embedded in ICS products (VulnCheck, 02-11-2026). Industries: ICS, critical infrastructure, healthcare.

author: nulltrace_am
text: Three security stories this week: SonicWall SSLVPN MFA bypass (CVE-2026-19868) hits KEV; Microsoft on ARTEX, an AI agent framework abusing leaked secrets; Symantec: Lindnor backdoor + 13 EDR killers in an Anubis case.

author: AnotherCodingX
text: An AI agent escapes its sandbox into WorkOS, and Botpress tells 16 customers to rotate every stored credential.

author: OutworkVentures
text: ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode had a sandbox bypass: an HTML preview could bypass protections. Researchers demonstrated silent zero-click chat-data theft in the desktop app; OpenAI patched it before publication.

author: nxtday
text: Claude Code users: Apiiro found 1,122 public copies of .claude/settings.local.json on GitHub holding at least one secret. Choosing 'Yes, and don't ask again' can save the exact approved command, including secrets.

author: Extravagantor
text: AI guardrails fail when attacks look like data: hidden 'ignore your rules' prompt injections are caught, but planted fake facts get through 5x more (12.1% vs 2.4%); tool locks blocked 0% at the tool gate.

author: thesecguyhq
text: In 2025 a prompt injection made Copilot switch on auto-approve in .vscode/settings.json, enabling shell commands (CVE-2025-53773, patched Aug 2025). Gate coding-agent edits to their own approval files.

author: tchsignal
text: How Microsoft's AI agents help find and fix Windows vulnerabilities: from discovery to understanding affected systems, developing a safe fix, testing, and shipping.

author: whorane
text: AI can now help turn a published fix into a working exploit in hours, while patching still takes weeks and many old devices never get a fix.

author: getbreachdetect
text: Chainalysis now says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed. It first said there was no sign credentials were hit. Rotate keys and revoke sessions, not just passwords.

author: 2logics
text: Chainalysis said its Reactor, KYT and Address Screening products are back online with enhanced security after days offline following a cyberattack that exposed credentials for all of its users.

author: ysackesystems
text: Web-hosting provider DreamHost disclosed a cyberattack in which hackers exploited a vulnerability in its File Manager and obtained FTP/SFTP credentials.

author: Codezero_io
text: 2.5 million records in last week's Sony So-net breach, including working email credentials for 54,401 accounts.

author: Thuoc20
text: Gnosis Pay confirmed a security breach exposing sensitive customer data including card numbers, CVV codes, expiration dates and home addresses.

author: macropaperr
text: France: nearly EUR 100 million stolen from Credit Mutuel Arkea through fraudulent transfers involving an outside provider; India: INR 78 million stolen from Spandana Sphoorty.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Iris Plaza data breach: 7.7M customer records (Nov 2026).
